# Zoom Integration for Webinars/Classes
import requests
import jwt

ZOOM_API_KEY = "GN5b7vpmtG8N7WrDj1KV2ECEs11F7kRGvt5u"
ZOOM_API_SECRET = "your_secret"

def create_zoom_webinar(topic, start_time, duration=60):
    """Create a Zoom webinar"""
    # Generate JWT token
    token = jwt.encode(
        {
            "iss": ZOOM_API_KEY,
            "exp": datetime.now() + timedelta(hours=1)
        },
        ZOOM_API_SECRET,
        algorithm="HS256"
    )
    
    response = requests.post(
        "https://api.zoom.us/v2/users/me/webinars",
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"},
        json={
            "topic": topic,
            "type": 5,
            "start_time": start_time,
            "duration": duration,
            "timezone": "UTC"
        }
    )
    return response.json()
